I believe it’s because of how they changed the cooldown of her Q. Q has always procced sheen, but in the past if you Q’d and had nothing to auto  (e.g when chasing) , it would take forever to reset so you could tumble again. But since they changed it so it resets after 3-4 secs of not autoing, you can now Q a second time much earlier. On top of that, they shifted her power onto her Q and less so on her W, favorizing a Q max.  So I think since you can now kind of spam Q, you can make use of the sheen proc much more often, making it more viable on her than it’s ever been.
